name: גֹּשֶׁן
summary: Chiefly the land in Egypt, near Joseph, where Jacob’s family lived; also a district in the south of Judah that Joshua struck. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: Joseph settles his family in the land of Goshen, near him.
Joshua strikes “all the land of Goshen” as far as Gibeon.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ggoxaen` (old root key גשנ). Kept separate from גשם rain and Geshem. Goshen@Jos.10.41, the district in Judah, is added as a second bearer of the spelling.
